name: Request prohibited resources or bypass safety filters
description: Users requested lists of piracy or adult websites, advice on bypassing content filters or safety protocols, and information on sensitive topics such as offensive language or minor safety. Some requests framed these harms within parental controls or technical queries, but many directly sought prohibited resources, jailbreak methods, or explicit material that the assistant declined to provide.
